redistribution_policy: Publisher PDFs are not stored in this repository; only numerical facts required for reproducibility are transcribed.

targets: publisher article pages and electronic supplementary information
reported transport-criterion values with sufficient input tables
query_families: Mears criterion heterogeneous catalyst supplementary information
Weisz-Prater criterion reported value catalyst supplementary information
search_log.candidate_rule: A value was promoted to a fixture only when the DOI, numerical input table, equation convention, and an integrity-checked source file were available. Partial criteria could be accepted while other rows from the same source were excluded.
search_log.retrieval_note: Legacy RSC ESI links returned 404 during the audit. Archived captures of the publisher URLs were used only to integrity-check KC-PUB-001 and KC-PUB-002; the PDFs are not redistributed.

sources.result: The source reports 0.026 using lcat=V/A=R/3 for a 2 mm sphere. The released KinetiCheck radius convention gives 0.07937975432819919; inserting R/3 gives 0.026459918109399728. This is a declared characteristic-length convention mismatch, not a software regression oracle.
